title: The Defiant Jazz Incident: play statistics
description: Anonymous play statistics for the game, from its Faro events in Loki. Headless Chrome and visits without a player id are filtered out.

panels.title: Players and visits
panels.description: Players are distinct player ids that started the game; visits are distinct page loads (every load is a new Faro session). Headless Chrome and visits with no player id (a draft of the Page, or user storage failing) are left out.

targets.expr: count(sum by (user_id)(count_over_time({service_name="defiant-jazz", kind="event", deployment_environment=~"$environment"} | logfmt | event_domain="defiant-jazz" | browser_name!="Chrome Headless" | user_attr_player_id_source="user_storage" | user_id!~"$exclude" | event_name="game_started" [$__range])))

count(sum by (session_id)(count_over_time({service_name="defiant-jazz", kind="event", deployment_environment=~"$environment"} | logfmt | event_domain="defiant-jazz" | browser_name!="Chrome Headless" | user_attr_player_id_source="user_storage" | user_id!~"$exclude" | event_name="game_started" [$__range])))

count(sum by (user_id)(count_over_time({service_name="defiant-jazz", kind="event", deployment_environment=~"$environment"} | logfmt | event_domain="defiant-jazz" | browser_name!="Chrome Headless" | user_attr_player_id_source="user_storage" | user_id!~"$exclude" | event_name="game_started" | event_data_resumed="true" [$__range])))

panels.title: Clues opened
panels.description: Distinct players who opened each clue marker (picture name and marker number), most opened first.

targets.expr: sort_desc(count by (event_data_clue, event_data_label)(sum by (event_data_clue, event_data_label, user_id)(count_over_time({service_name="defiant-jazz", kind="event", deployment_environment=~"$environment"} | logfmt | event_domain="defiant-jazz" | browser_name!="Chrome Headless" | user_attr_player_id_source="user_storage" | user_id!~"$exclude" | event_name="clue_opened" [$__range]))))
